setup.command: uv venv --allow-existing target/site-venv && uv pip install --python target/site-venv/bin/python markdown==3.10

run.command: MDM_SITE_NO_STATS=1 target/site-venv/bin/python tools/website/build.py && target/site-venv/bin/python -m http.server 3000 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory target/site
